operations: Stretch original empty blue lower-left strip across the 1023x150 base.
Nine-slice assembly using only original top-left corner, unobstructed top edge and unobstructed left edge pixels.
Mirror original left corner/edge to reconstruct the right side without the red close button.
Vertically mirror original upper edge and corners for the lower edge, because the video clips the actual bottom.
Resize source regions with Lanczos only; no drawing, generated illustration, new texture, text or icons.
alpha: Fully opaque RGBA (all alpha255), including original gray corner background; covers existing neighbor-slot frames.
limitations: Lower edge is reconstructed from mirrored original top pixels; the complete lower original border is unavailable.
The original clean blue strip is stretched as a simple background; original promotional artwork and text are excluded.
This is a technical raster assembly, not a recovered standalone original asset.
